scripts.build: npm run build:widget && npm run build:server
scripts.build:widget: esbuild src/comments/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/comments.mjs --banner:js="// AUTOGENERATED FROM src/comments/*.ts — DO NOT EDIT. Rebuild with: npm run build" --sourcemap=inline
scripts.build:server: esbuild src/comments/serve.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=node18 --platform=node --outfile=dist/serve.mjs --banner:js="// AUTOGENERATED FROM src/comments/*.ts — DO NOT EDIT. Rebuild with: npm run build"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test && npm run test:smoke
